verses.geez: ወኢትክዓው፡ ንዋየከ፡ በከንቱ፡ ወኢትበል፡ ኮንየ፡ አከለኒ።
verses.translation: Set not thy heart upon thy goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.

translations.lxx: Set not thy heart upon thy goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.
translations.ron: Nu nădăjdui în avuţiile tale şi să nu zici: Am destule.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἔπεχε ἐπὶ τοῖς χρήμασί σου, καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς, αὐτάρκη μοι ἐστί.

verses.translation: Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart:

translations.lxx: Follow not thine own mind and thy strength, to walk in the ways of thy heart:
translations.ron: Nu urma dorinţelor şi tăriei tale, ca să umbli în poftele inimii tale.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐξακολούθει τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ τῇ ἰσχύϊ σου, τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις καρδίας σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትበል፡ ኀያል፡ አነ፡ ወመኑ፡ ይክለኒ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በቀለ፡ ይትቤቀል።
verses.translation: and say not, Who shall control me for my works? for the Lord will surely revenge thy pride.

translations.lxx: and say not, Who shall control me for my works? for the Lord will surely revenge thy pride.
translations.ron: şi să nu zici: Cine mă va smeri sau cine mă va supune? Că Domnul nu va întârzia să te pedepsească.
translations.grk: Καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς, τίς με δυναστεύσει; ὁ γὰρ Κύριος ἐκδικῶν ἐκδικήσει σε.

verses.geez: ወኢትበል፡ አበስኩሂ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተፈደይኩ፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይትዔገሥ፡ ጕንዱየ።
verses.translation: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.

translations.lxx: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm hath happened unto me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let thee go.
translations.ron: Să nu zici: Am păcătuit şi ce mi s-a făcut mie? Că Domnul este îndelung-răbdător.
translations.grk: Μὴ εἶπῃς, ἥμαρτον, καὶ τί μοι ἐγένετο; ὁ γὰρ Κυριός ἐστι μακρόθυμος.

verses.geez: ወኢትፍራህ፡ ተጋንዮ፡ በእንተ፡ ኀጢአትከ፡ ወኢትወስክ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ በዲበ፡ ኀጢአትከ፡ እንዘ፡ ትብል፡ ብዙኅ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin:

translations.lxx: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin unto sin:
translations.ron: Pentru curăţie să nu fii fără de frică, ca să nu adaugi păcate peste păcate.
translations.grk: Περὶ ἐξιλασμοῦ μὴ ἄφοβος γίνου προσθεῖναι ἁμαρτίαν ἐφʼ ἁμαρτίαις.

verses.geez: ምሕረትኒ፡ ወመቅሠፍትኒ፡ እምኀቤሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ይወርድ፡ መቅሠፍቱ።
verses.translation: and say not, His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.

translations.lxx: and say not, His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.
translations.ron: Şi să nu zici: Mila Lui este mare, va curăţi mulţimea păcatelor mele.
translations.grk: Καὶ μὴ εἴπῃς, ὁ οἰκτιρμὸς αὐτοῦ πολὺς, τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν μου ἐξιλάσεται· ἔλεος γὰρ καὶ ὀργὴ παρʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπὶ ἁμαρτωλοὺς καταπαύσει ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ኢታጐንዲ፡ ተጋንዮ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢታስተኀልፍ፡ ዕለተ፡ እምዕለት፡ እስመ፡ ግብተ፡ ትመጽእ፡ መንሱት፡ ወትትመነደብ፡ አመ፡ ትመጽእ፡ ፍዳከ፡ ወመቅሠፍትከ።
verses.translation: Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in thy security thou shalt be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.

translations.lxx: Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in thy security thou shalt be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.
translations.ron: Că mila şi mânia de la El sunt şi peste cei păcătoşi va odihni mânia Lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀνάμενε ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ μὴ ὑπερβάλλου ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας· ἐξάπινα γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ὀργὴ Κυρίου, καὶ ἐν καιρῷ ἐκδικήσεως ἐξολῇ.

verses.geez: ኢትሰቈቊ፡ ለንዋየ፡ ዓመፃ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይክል፡ አድኅኖተከ፡ አመ፡ ምንዳቤከ።
verses.translation: Set not thine heart upon goods unjustly gotten; for they shall not profit thee in the day of calamity.

translations.lxx: Set not thine heart upon goods unjustly gotten; for they shall not profit thee in the day of calamity.
translations.ron: Nu întârzia a te întoarce la Domnul şi nu amâna din zi în zi.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἔπεχε ἐπὶ χρήμασιν ἀδίκοις, οὐδὲν γὰρ ὠφελήσεις ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπαγωγῆς.

verses.geez: ወኢታብቁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘነፍስ፡ ወኢትትሉ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘፈተውከ፡ ወኢትኩን፡ ከመ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ዘክልኤ፡ ልሳኑ።
verses.translation: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so doth the sinner that hath a double tongue.

translations.lxx: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so doth the sinner that hath a double tongue.
translations.ron: Că fără de veste va izbucni mânia Domnului şi în vremea răzbunării vei fi dat pieirii.
translations.grk: Μὴ λίκμα ἐν παντὶ ἀνέμῳ, καὶ μὴ πορεύου ἐν πάσῃ ἀτραπῷ· οὕτως ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ὁ δίγλωσσος.

verses.geez: አንተሰ፡ አስምክ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጥበብከ፡ ወአሐደ፡ ይኩን፡ ቃልከ።
verses.translation: Be stedfast in thy understanding; and let thy word be the same.

translations.lxx: Be stedfast in thy understanding; and let thy word be the same.
translations.ron: Nu te încrede în avuţiile câştigate pe nedrept, că nimic nu-ţi vor folosi în ziua judecăţii.
translations.grk: Ἴσθι ἐστηριγμένος ἐν συνέσει σου, καὶ εἷς ἔστω σου ὁ λόγος.

verses.geez: ወኩን፡ ፍጡነ፡ ለሰሚዕ፡ ወመስተዓግሠ፡ ለአውሥኦ፡ ቃል።
verses.translation: Be swift to hear; and let thy life be sincere; and with patience give answer.

translations.lxx: Be swift to hear; and let thy life be sincere; and with patience give answer.
translations.ron: Nu vântura la orice vânt şi nu umbla pe orice cale; aşa este păcătosul cel cu două limbi.
translations.grk: Γίνου ταχὺς ἐν ἀκροάσει σου, καὶ ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ φθέγγου ἀπόκρισιν.

verses.geez: እመ፡ ብከ፡ ዘታየድዖ፡ ንግሮ፡ ለቢጽከ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ ደይ፡ እዴከ፡ ላዕለ፡ አፉከ።
verses.translation: If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.

translations.lxx: If thou hast understanding, answer thy neighbour; if not, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.
translations.ron: Fii statornic în cugetul tău şi unul să fie cuvântul tău.
translations.grk: Εἰ ἔστι σοι σύνεσις, ἀποκρίθητι τῷ πλησίον· εἰ δὲ μὴ, ἡ χείρ σου ἔστω ἐπὶ στόματί σου.

verses.geez: ኀሣርከኒ፡ ወክብርከኒ፡ እምቃልከኒ፡ ወእምልሳኑ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ድቀቱ።
verses.translation: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.

translations.lxx: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.
translations.ron: Fii grabnic la ascultat şi zăbavnic la dat răspunsul.
translations.grk: Δόξα καὶ ἀτιμία ἐν λαλιᾷ, καὶ γλῶσσα ἀνθρώπου πτῶσις αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ኢትኩን፡ ሐማዬ፡ ወኢትዘለፍ፡ በልሳንከ፡ እስመ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ ኀፍረቱ፡ ለሰራቂ፡ ወእኪት፡ ኀሣሩ፡ ለዘክልኤ፡ ልሳኑ።
verses.translation: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with thy tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.

translations.lxx: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with thy tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.
translations.ron: De ştii, răspunde aproapelui tău, iar de nu, pune-ţi mâna peste gură.
translations.grk: Μὴ κληθῇς ψίθυρος, καὶ τῇ γλώσσῃ σου μὴ ἐνέδρευε· ἐπὶ γὰρ τῷ κλέπτῃ ἐστὶν αἰσχύνη, καὶ κατάγνωσις πονηρὰ ἐπὶ διγλώσσου.

verses.geez: በኀበ፡ ዐቢይኒ፡ ወበኀበ፡ ንዑስኒ፡ አስተርኢ፡ ኄረ።
verses.translation: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.

translations.lxx: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.
translations.ron: Mărirea şi batjocura sunt în vorbă şi limba omului îi face să cadă.
translations.grk: Ἐν μεγάλῳ καὶ ἐν μικρῷ μὴ ἀγνόει.
